# Rename File

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Renames the given file.

## Syntax

~~~~text
renameFile(file: <#Variable#>, name: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
renameFile(file: ShortcutInput, name: "Super Cool File Names")
~~~~
